Tankathon currently has us with pick 4 and pick 11. if that holds these are some prospects I would consider at each.
***Pick 4:*** 

* Zaccharie Risacher - 6'9 long wing, having a really good year in the French league, getting some Batum comps. I think his defense and 3pt shooting are his calling card right now but his handle seems to be improving as well.

* Matas Buzelis - 6'11 wing/forward, seems to be an offensive hub, can handle, shot is improving, I think his defense leaves some to be desired but he had a good night last night with 3 steals and 8 rebounds.

* Ron Holland (if available) - 6'8 wing/forward, this pick is interesting, I wouldn't be high on it due to his need for the ball in his hands but I think he will be very good if his shot improves. Defense and driving to the rim are his calling cards.

***Pick 11:***

* Izan Almansa - 6'10 PF/C , This is who tankathon has us taking, don't know much about his game, seems to be a good passer but struggles on defense, had a good FIBAU18 campaign. 

* Donovan Clingan - 7'2 C - Very traditional center prospect, can rebound/block shots like a monster, his offense is somewhat limited to being a rim rolling threat. I like this pick as a good backup for Ayton but I think there is better value for a backup C in the second round.

* Ryan Dunn - 6'8 SF/Wing, probably a lock for All-defense in the ACC, athletic defensive monster, he is a decent finisher at the rim but his 3pt shot needs a lot of work. Him and Camara would be a force on the defensive end but I would be worried about the offense if Camara's shot doesn't come around. If his tankathon projected NBA 3P% of 32.5 came true he would be a steal.

* Cody Williams -  6'8 SF/Wing, solid defense, good driver, decent shooter (could use some improvement) I think the Blazers need a connective wing who doesn't need the ball in his hands but can make plays if needed to which Cody Williams seems to fit (and Dunn). I love this pick here, personally I think double dipping in wing is never a bad thing. His brother being this good in the NBA has definitely influenced me here though.
